title: Reading the book: editing and authority
shortTitle: Reading the book: editing and authority
summary: Read an edited opinion, an editor’s insertion, and a note as distinct kinds of source.
notes: The book’s front matter explains that brackets identify editorial additions, some opinions are abridged, and note/problem citations suggest a line of thought rather than necessarily an answer. This notebook follows those distinctions. An opinion’s quoted statute is the law discussed there; its presence in a 2023 casebook does not establish present validity. Exact assigned pages remain available beside the study layer.
